text:
maria: quick heads-up — during the quant4b bring-up I noticed the buffered holdout eviction kicked in and pulled a handful of golden examples into the active samplebank. could be why we're seeing a blip in evals.

sam: wait, golden examples moved into active sampling? how many roughly? :eyes: 

maria: ~18 across two shards. they are short Q/A style prompts, the dedupe score threshold dropped because of tokenization differences after quantized conversion.

jonah: that matches the regression signal we saw on short prompts — quality dropped for answers that were previously passing the golden checks. are we sure it was eviction and not a de-dupe false negative?

maria: dug into logs — eviction policy triggered because `buffered_holdout.size > config.max_buffer` and the eviction comparator used raw-hash instead of canonicalized fingerprint. see snippet I pulled:```python
# eviction comparator (simplified)
def evict(candidate, buffer):
    return candidate.raw_hash not in {b.raw_hash for b in buffer}
```

maria: so when quantized tokenizer changed whitespace normalization, raw_hash changed and comparator thought they were new.

alesha: ugh. can we short-circuit: re-run dedupe on buffer with canonical fingerprints and then push a defensive policy to prevent eviction for items in `golden_set`?

sam: yes — immediate mitigation: mark any fingerprint that exists in `golden_index` as protected. I can flip a hotfix flag on labeler service.

label-bot: automated alert: golden_protection_hotfix toggled by @sam at 2024-11-12T15:12Z :white_check_mark:

jonah: for a fix, we should regenerate fingerprints from canonical pipeline (lowercase, unicode normalize, strip punctuation) and compare. i'll open a small task to batch-recompute.

maria: +1. also we should re-run the quant smoke eval restricted to short prompts only to verify the regression is from golden leakage vs model degradation.

alesha: labeling ops impact: if those gold examples are already in active labeling queues, we need to pull their jobs and reassign them as gold. sam — can you coordinate? we'll need to stop any in-progress labeler tasks and credit labelers.

sam: on it. plan: 1) identify active jobs referencing golden fingerprints 2) cancel and tag as `gold_recall` 3) requeue to gold-assurance pool. estimated time ~20m. will post updates.

maria: also FYI, quant pipeline change log shows tokenizer tweak landed in `quant-prep v1.3.2` last night — tagging infra to roll back if needed.

jonah: longer-term: change comparator to use canonical fingerprint + include tokenizer-version in sample metadata so we can detect tokenization drift automatically. add to RFC?

maria: yes — i'll draft a short RFC and include migration plan for existing buffers.

alesha: for labeler compensation: suggest giving affected labelers 1 extra review credit per canceled task and flag for ops to reconcile.

sam: done. will add credit and send a thank-you note.

maria: immediate action list: 1) @sam flip hotfix (done) 2) @jonah re-fingerprint batch job (in progress) 3) @maria run short-prompt quant smoke (queued) 4) @alesha coordinate labeler recall (in progress)

label-bot: job update: `recompute-fingerprints-shard-7` started by @jonah at 2024-11-12T15:20Z

maria: will post final status once we have smoke results. thanks all. :pray:
